meta.name: dask
meta.description: Distributed computing for larger-than-RAM pandas/NumPy workflows. Use when you need to scale existing pandas/NumPy code beyond memory or across clusters. Best for parallel file processing, distributed ML, integration with existing pandas code. For out-of-core analytics on single machine use vaex; for in-memory speed use polars.

copy.tagline_en: Scale your pandas/NumPy workflows beyond memory on distributed clusters.
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you need to process datasets too large for a single machine's memory.

howto.what: 装上后,Claude 会用 Dask 把超出内存的 pandas/NumPy 代码改成并行分块计算,能并行读取多个文件、搭 ETL 流程、跑分布式任务并返回计算结果。
howto.when: 当数据超出内存、需要把 pandas/NumPy 代码扩展到多核或多机集群,或要并行处理多个文件时触发。

howto.what_en: Once installed, Claude uses Dask to rewrite pandas/NumPy code that exceeds memory into lazy, chunked parallel computation, handling multi-file reads, ETL pipelines and distributed tasks, then computing results.
howto.when_en: Use when data exceeds RAM, when pandas/NumPy code must scale across cores or a cluster, or when many files need parallel processing.
